verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions workflows are defined 'right in your repository' (github-docs-38), which implies they are version-controlled alongside code. Changes can go through branch diffs, pull requests and Copilot code review (github-docs-26, github-docs-25), though the evidence never ties review explicitly to automation definitions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of versioning workflow/automation definitions, an explicit review flow for automation changes, any evidence of rollback/revert of automations, independent corroboration.
